blocks.value: You cannot directly walk into the NSE or BSE and buy shares yourself. You need a registered stock broker.

Imagine This: When buying a house, most people work through a real estate agent who helps complete the transaction. In the stock market, a broker performs a similar role by helping investors buy and sell shares.
A stock broker is a SEBI-registered company that provides a platform to buy and sell shares on stock exchanges.
Popular stock brokers in India include Zerodha, Groww, Angel One, Upstox and ICICI Direct.
When you click 'Buy' in Zerodha or Groww, your broker sends your order to the stock exchange.

blocks.question: Why do investors need a stock broker?
choices: To access the stock exchange and place buy/sell orders.
